runs.text: Read 4 contacts, each with name, phone and birthday month, and then a name. Show that name's phone, or
. If the name appears more than once, show the first.

It is the search of the contact list in
Keep the contacts in a vector of cards and search it; be careful with repeated names.
Walk through the vector and keep the phone only the first time the name matches. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Also show how many classmates have their birthday in the same month as the searched one.
Hidden cases: a missing name, the last one on the list and a repeated name (the first wins). Frequent mistake: replacing the phone on each match, which returns the last one.
